points.point: The Vault's signal integrity capability list is a high-speed PCB/PCBA flow: IL / Xtalk / eye diagram, TDR impedance, Stackup Planner, TL Calculator — not a wireless-application list.
points.label: contradicted
points.why: lists PCB/PCBA SI flow but then treats it as wireless SI set

points.point: Signal Integrity is positioned in the Digital / high-speed digital test context, with RF as a separate target category, so the Vault does not frame SI as a wireless-communication capability area.
points.label: contradicted
points.why: frames wireless/RF analysis as SI capabilities

points.point: In the R&S PCB test solutions flow, Signal Integrity modeling/testing is defined as IL, DK/DF, roughness and impedance.
points.label: partial
points.why: mentions IL and impedance, omits DK/DF and roughness definition

points.point: The only wireless-infrastructure SI reference is O-RU / Open RAN testing, where "Timing / Sync / Signal Integrity" is listed as one key test focus area.
points.label: missing
points.why: does not state O-RU Timing/Sync/Signal Integrity focus area

points.point: In the Jio mmWave (Wi-Fi over mmWave) project, signal integrity is tied to EVM/modulation-quality tuning after signal up-conversion.
points.label: missing
points.why: no Jio mmWave up-conversion SI/EVM context

points.point: In an SDR/UAV wireless review, filtering stages plus configurable AGC are what mitigate interference and maintain signal integrity.
points.label: missing
points.why: no SDR/UAV filtering plus AGC statement

invented: Wireless-standard vector signal analysis is a supported capability
used for 5G NR, LTE, O-RAN U-Plane / PCAP analysis and beamforming measurements
5G NR signal analysis is supported with presets for 5G NR test models
O-RAN signal analysis is supported with VSE-K175
predefined test signals according to the WG4.CONF.0 test specification
EVM measurement is a key supported RF quality capability
measurement results must be below the 3GPP TS 38.521-1 maximum error percentage
CMX500 supports LTE, NR FR1, NR FR2, NSA, SA, FDD and TDD device testing
CMP180 supports production and wireless communication device testing
CMP180 RF analyzer capabilities include 250 MHz IF bandwidth, or 500 MHz
FSWX signal analysis bandwidth reaches up to 4 GHz per RF input and up to 8 GHz

combining wireless-standard vector signal analysis, EVM, O-RAN/beamforming analysis, multiport RF analysis, wideband spectrum analysis, jitter/clock validation and PCB channel validation as the main signal-integrity capability set
